# Session Menu - Helps control Session state while using the Atayana Indicators stack
The Session menu lets you change your user's status, Stop your session, control system power state. Adheres to the Atayana Indicator library spec.

## Features
 - User can change their status
 - User can switch to another user
 - User can Close their session
 - User can control the system power state
 - Aids user experience while using the Atayana Indicators stack
